user.title: Connect Mealie Discover
user.description: Enter the Mealie URL reachable from Home Assistant, an API token, and at least one search provider: a SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled and/or a YouTube Data API key. Found add-ons: {detected}. Create the Mealie API token in Mealie under your profile → API Tokens.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Mealie Discover
reconfigure.description: Enter the Mealie URL reachable from Home Assistant, an API token, and at least one search provider: a SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled and/or a YouTube Data API key. Found add-ons: {detected}. Create the Mealie API token in Mealie under your profile → API Tokens.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials or query parameters
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Mealie from Home Assistant, or the URL is not Mealie's API address
error.searxng_unreachable: Cannot reach SearXNG from Home Assistant
error.searxng_json: SearXNG refused JSON output. Add "json" to search.formats in settings.yml
